items.title: Joe Watkins Interview, 1961-01-20
items.q: I never did hear Bill play drums. But he'd always told me that he was a drummer, too.

ctx.x: Yeah. Yeah. Yeah, I get you. Let's see. Oh, yeah. Well, I'm Howard. I hear Howard play drums. Yeah, he did that one time. How did he play? Before he picked up the trumpet. Remember? Howard played good drums. He played good drums. Yeah, he played good drums. And a lot of these musicians seem to be playing drums, you know, like, what's the guy's name, Bill Matthews, he used to play drums.
Bill Matthews used to play drums? Yeah.
